title: The Amazing World of Gumball
description: The life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year old cat who attends middle school in Elmore. Accompanied by his pet, adoptive brother, and best friend Darwin Watterson, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with various family members: Anais, Richard, and Nicole Watterson, and other various citizens.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x1
episodes_data.description: An overdue DVD causes chaos (and a hefty fee) for Gumball and Darwin.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x2
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin get to babysit Anais whilst their parents go to a PTA meeting but being "responsible" has a different meaning when you don't know what it means.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x3
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin grow bored of one another and seek out a third friend to make their lives more exciting.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x4
episodes_data.description: Believing that his life had been saved, Gumball vows to repay his debt by saving Mr. Robinson's life.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x5
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin, thinking that the world will end in 24 hours, decide to make the most out of their remaining time.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x6
episodes_data.description: When his clothes are shrunk in the washing machine by his father, Gumball is forced to wear his mother's wedding dress to school.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x7
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin help Anais get her beloved doll back after it is lost on the way to school.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x8
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin become unwitting accomplices in a stick-up at a gas station.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x9
episodes_data.description: When Masami claims that Darwin is her boyfriend, Gumball vows to help his friend before he gets kissed.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x10
episodes_data.description: After seeing a picture that Anais drew, Principal Brown assumes that Anais finds her family dysfunctional, so he begins to meddle in their family life.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x11
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin challenge their father to a laziness competition, with the loser having to do the winner's chores.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x12
episodes_data.description: When a ghost named Carrie possesses Gumball's body in order to feel earthly experiences and to eat, he must learn to say "no" to her.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x13
episodes_data.description: Gumball decides to investigate when his class finds Principal Brown wrapped up in toilet paper, shaved and, covered in green paint, or else face detention.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x14
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin's pranks on their father get out of hand.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x15
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin are ridiculed for their martial-arts outfits by their schoolmates, and their mom tries to convince them to take them off.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x16
episodes_data.description: A kiss from Grandma JoJo traumatizes Gumball, and Darwin attempts to help him forget.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x17
episodes_data.description: Gumball and his friends are invited to a high-school party hosted by Tobias's sister Rachel, but they must find dates in order to attend.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 1x18
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin go to great lengths to get their money back from an incompatible video game, but the rental store's policy prevents them from getting it.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x1
episodes_data.description: The Watterson family fights over the remote when they realize everything they want to watch comes on at the same time.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x2
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin upset a giant.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x3
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Tobias compete for Penny's affection by putting on the lamest duel in history.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x4
episodes_data.description: Mom tries to inspire Gumball to develop ambition.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x5
episodes_data.description: Gumball is jealous when he sees Leslie with Penny.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x6
episodes_data.description: Gumball seeks justice when Banana Joe chews Darwin's pen.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x7
episodes_data.description: Darwin develops a texting addiction when he and Gumball get their first cell phone.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x8
episodes_data.description: Richard gets a job as a pizza delivery man, which worries Nicole when strange things begin to occur around the neighborhood.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x9
episodes_data.description: Gumball, Darwin and Anais go to a haunted-house party.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x10
episodes_data.description: Anais hunts for hidden treasure after uncovering a secret.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x11
episodes_data.description: Ms. Simian owes Gumball an apology.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x12
episodes_data.description: Darwin tries to be more direct with Gumball as his teacher.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x13
episodes_data.description: The guys befriend a compulsive liar.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x14
episodes_data.description: Bobert becomes Gumball's servant and obeys every command he receives.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x15
episodes_data.description: Santa Claus is coming to town. Unfortunately he gets run over by the Wattersons, so it's up to them to save Christmas.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x16
episodes_data.description: The guys try to retrieve a family heirloom from an old man.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x17
episodes_data.description: Gumball envies rural life and asks Idaho to teach his family to live like potatoes.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x18
episodes_data.description: Darwin abandons Gumball when faced with a beating by Tina, so Gumball plots revenge.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x19
episodes_data.description: After Richard is hospitalized from an accident, Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger, which leads Nicole to disagree with her parenting style.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 2x20
episodes_data.description: An evil virus seeks vengeance on Gumball, Darwin, and Teri after they wipe out his army of bacteria.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x1
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin's voices may be breaking, but they're showing no signs of growing up. Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mom and Dad for being old, their voices start to break. They try to ignore it, but everybody they meet reacts to their new and unpredictable voices.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x2
episodes_data.description: New Elmore Junior High student Sarah becomes Gumball and Darwin's obsessive number-one fan.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x3
episodes_data.description: The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. The new Coach witnesses Jamie bullying the other kids at lunch and steps in. Jamie is made to apologize, much to the amazement of the other kids. Gumball and Darwin worry about Jamie seeking revenge, especially when they see him sneaking into the back of Coach's car.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x4
episodes_data.description: When Mrs. Simian sees Gumball and Darwin joyful on Monday, she knows that something is wrong with them. She performs tests on them, but the nurse disapproves what she's doing. But suddenly, Gumball and Darwin start to infect the school with the 'Joy Virus', and it's up to Mrs Simian and her tape player to cure the students.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Watterson children's long-awaited pet puppy turns out to be a turtle which hates them.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x6
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin discover the secret behind their classmate Anton's immortality.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x7
episodes_data.description: When Mom reveals that Gumball's real name is "Zach," Gumball adopts a cheesy, annoying persona to match the name. His family tries to make him remember the old Gumball, as this new Zach persona is progressively taking over Gumball's life and erasing his memories.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x8
episodes_data.description: Skits about the random extra characters seen throughout the series.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x9
episodes_data.description: When Gumball and Darwin begin to complain about every little thing in their lives, the people of Elmore City mistakenly assumes charity cases and put together a benefit to raise money for them, leaving them having to fix the mix-up.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x10
episodes_data.description: While driving to a campground, Michelle tells a horror story, which slowly starts to come true as their car breaks down and a stranger comes to help them out.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x11
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin discover Principal Brown's diploma is fake, and Principal Brown is determined to keep their discovery a secret.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x12
episodes_data.description: When Gumball and Darwin investigate a missing classmate, they discover a far greater mystery... about Elmore.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x13
episodes_data.description: Mr. Robertson has a stress attack and needs a  stuffing transfusion from his son Rocky the janitor. He won't take it unless Rocky gets a better job in life. Rocky gets one with Chanax, where he becomes a work drone. Gumball and Darwin now need to get Rocky's soul back from his boss in order to get him to surgery.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x14
episodes_data.description: Clayton, a compulsive liar tells Gumball and Darwin about his awesome martial arts move, and discover that he wasn't lying.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x15
episodes_data.description: The Doughnut Sheriff shows Gumball and Darwin that the smallest misdemeanor can lead to a breakdown in law.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x16
episodes_data.description: Gumball needs to find a cure for Darwin's allergy before he sneezes Elmore off the map.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x17
episodes_data.description: It's Mother's Day and kids put their moms through a series of tests to determine who has the World's Greatest Mom.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x18
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin are shocked to discover that Anais is Dad's favorite child.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x19
episodes_data.description: Gumball and Darwin spend the day doing other things instead of taking out the trash like their mother told them to do before she got back home.

episodes_data.title: The Amazing World of Gumball 3x20
episodes_data.description: Gumball inadvertently cracks open Penny's shell, and discovers who she really is inside...
